title: Inverted Podcast #22 — 'Become Incorruptible'
summary: The Inverted Podcast — hosted by Jeroen, Dana, and Dario — drops a launch-day episode using Costco, Cloudflare, and Anthropic as case studies for how trust, governance, and long-term purpose become competitive advantages rather than ideals.
blockquote: Eric shares powerful stories from companies like Costco, Cloudflare, and Anthropic, explaining how trust, governance, and long-term purpose can become real competitive advantages—not just ideals.
attribution_title: Hosted by Jeroen, Dana, and Dario
